build_granite_causal_lm: build a GraniteForCausalLM model with custom embedding, residual, and logits scaling for causal language modeling
create_granite_attention: create a GraniteAttention module with configurable attention multiplier for multi-headed attention
build_granite_decoder_layer: build a GraniteDecoderLayer with residual multiplier and GraniteAttention for transformer decoder blocks
build_granite_model: build a GraniteModel with embedding multiplier and stacked GraniteDecoderLayers as the base transformer
run_granite_forward: run a GraniteForCausalLM forward pass with input_ids, attention_mask, and optional past_key_values for generation
